Column Technical Services is looking for a talented
**Business Support Center Representative**
to join our team and serve as a trusted resource for employees across the organization. In this role, you'll provide front-line support, work with Workday and other business systems, collaborate with multiple departments, and help drive a positive employee experience. This is an excellent opportunity for a customer-focused professional who enjoys troubleshooting, building relationships, and contributing to process improvements while expanding their HR and business operations expertise. Ready to make an impact from day one? Apply today and grow your career!

**This position is
not
eligible for visa sponsorship. Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States without current or future sponsorship. Candidates who reside in New York or New Jersey are encouraged to apply, as they will be required to report to the office onsite during January and February for go-live and hypercare support.**

**Position Summary**

The Business Support Center Representative serves as the first point of contact for employee inquiries received through various channels, including phone, email, and other communication methods. This role delivers exceptional customer service with a focus on resolving issues during the initial interaction whenever possible. The representative develops and maintains knowledge of HR programs, policies, procedures, and systems while supporting issue identification, case creation, problem resolution, and escalation to specialized support teams when necessary.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Workday and Business Systems Support**

- Provide front-line support for employee transactions, system inquiries, and case resolution related to the Workday ERP implementation and existing Workday HCM platform.
- Deliver accurate and timely assistance through phone calls, service requests, and case management activities.
- Collaborate with teams across Human Resources, Finance, Information Technology, Supply Chain, Research, and other business areas to resolve system and process-related issues.
- Support user adoption initiatives, process enhancements, and end-user troubleshooting to ensure effective ERP and HCM operations.

**Tier 1 Customer Support and Resolution**

- Respond to employee and manager inquiries of basic to moderate complexity, utilizing established procedures, scripts, and knowledge resources to provide accurate information and solutions.
- Guide customers toward available self-service tools and resources, helping them become more proficient in navigating HR systems and knowledge bases.
- Utilize various systems and applications to research, track, and troubleshoot inquiries.
- Accurately document issues, determine appropriate next steps, and coordinate resolution efforts.
- Seek guidance from leadership when addressing unfamiliar or complex situations.
- Provide regular updates on open cases and ongoing issues through written and verbal communication.
- Professionally manage inbound and outbound communications with employees and managers.
- Conduct follow-up outreach as needed to ensure timely case resolution.
- Identify and resolve customer concerns while maintaining a positive customer experience.
- Deliver outstanding service by ensuring requests are handled accurately, professionally, and within established service-level expectations.
- Contribute to a high-quality service environment through responsiveness, accuracy, and consistent execution of transactions.

**HR Operations and Transaction Processing**

- Provide daily operational support for HR-related processes and applications, including Recruiting, Employee and Manager Self-Service, Absence Management, Performance Management, Benefits, Payroll, Compensation, and Finance functions.
- Process Workday transactions and provide concierge-level assistance when required.
- Perform proactive follow-up communications to ensure issues are resolved and customers remain informed.
- Execute transactions and operational tasks in accordance with established procedures and service standards.
- Partner with HR Business Partners and departmental leaders to resolve routine and low-complexity issues.
- Assist in onboarding and training newly hired HR Resource Center team members.

**Knowledge Management and Policy Support**

- Assist with the development, maintenance, and enhancement of HR knowledge base content.
- Remain informed of new system capabilities, policy updates, regulatory requirements, and compliance changes to support accurate guidance and communication.
- Partner with HR Business Partners and Centers of Excellence to gain understanding of both new and existing policies, procedures, and programs.

**Process Improvement and Project Support**

- Provide ongoing feedback to leadership regarding service trends, recurring issues, and opportunities to improve processes.
- Identify and recommend enhancements that streamline workflows, improve efficiency, and elevate service quality.
- Participate in testing activities for system enhancements, application updates, and related business processes.
- Evaluate the impact of system changes on employees, managers, and HR teams while helping to ensure successful implementation.

**Required Qualifications**

- High school diploma or GED.
- Strong customer service skills and a commitment to delivering a positive customer experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

- Up to two years of experience in a professional business environment
- Associate degree or vocational certification in Human Resources, Communications, or a related field.
- Experience supporting HR systems, shared services, customer support functions, or case management processes is a plus.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
- Strong problem-solving and analytical abilities.
- Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
- Attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
- Proficiency with business applications and customer support systems.
- Team-oriented with a collaborative and service-focused mindset.

RELOCATION ASSISTANCE: Relocation assistance may be available
  
  
CLEARANCE REQUIRED FOR START: Yes
  
  
CLEARANCE TYPE: Secret
  
  
TRAVEL: Yes, 50% of the Time
  
  
**Description**
At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.
  
  
Northrop Grumman Aeronautics Systems has an opening for a
**Staff Test Pilot**
to join the team of qualified individuals on our Test and Evaluation organization. This role is located onsite in
**Patuxent River, MD.**
In this role, the successful candidate will work as a highly motivated Test Pilot to support E-2D production acceptance flight tests and Foreign Military Sales.
  
  
Acceptance flights include new production and modification program induction, verification, sell off and delivery. Occasional collateral duties include the support of E-2D Integrated Test Team in Patuxent River, MD and various E-2 programs at Melbourne, Florida campus. ITT test program support include Aerial Refueling testing, Hawkeye Cockpit Technical Refresh development, Delta System Software Configuration upgrade development testing, and future missions systems development programs. Candidate will support engineering, systems safety, product support, and the E-2 program with development of systems and vehicle test plans, procedures, and test cards. Candidate will also provide NATOPS manual inputs and conduct E-2 aircrew training. Candidate shall display professionalism, leadership, have a strong work ethic, work well with others, and be able to function with little to no direct supervision. Additionally, the candidate will be required to provide training and mentorship to other pilots and engineers on the test team. Domestic and international travel up to 50% required. Extended international travel possible.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

- Develop and maintain air vehicle acceptance procedures to include technical justification
- Provide oversight for development of test plans / test cards to ensure safety and efficiency
- Lead pre-flight briefs to efficiently coordinate complex air vehicle testing with large team of aircrew and engineers.
- Lead post-flight debriefs to collect relevant test data and ensure lessons learned are captured for future testing
- Execute missions as pilot in command during flight test missions
- Coordinate group training events to encourage continued learning within the test team
- Mentor Pilots and Flight Test Engineers
- Incorporate “lessons learned” and process improvements to maintain / improve safety and efficiency within the team
- Author pilot daily reports highlighting details of test missions
- Manage NATOPS and aircrew training materials changes

We offer phenomenal learning opportunities, exposure to a wide variety of projects and customers, and a very friendly team environment. We are looking for self-motivated, proactive, and goal-oriented people to help us grow our services and become even better at what we do.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

- Must have a Bachelor of Science degree in a Science, Technology, Engineering, or Math (STEM) discipline AND 12 years of related professional/military experience OR a Master of Science degree in a STEM discipline AND 10 years of related professional/military experience, OR a STEM Ph.D. AND 8 years of related professional/military experience
- Must have an active US Government Secret (or higher) clearance (with a background investigation within the past 6 years or enrolled into Continuous Evaluation)
- Must have the ability to obtain and maintain Special Access Program (SAP) clearance, within a reasonable amount of time as determined by business needs
- Must have current or former E-2D pilot NATOPS Qualification.
- Must have at least 2,000 hours total time and 1,000 hours experience in E-2 or C-2.
- Must be able to pass FAA Class II physical as a condition of employment.
- Must have FAA commercial pilot certificate with multi-engine and instrument rating
- Must have FAA Radio Operators permit
- Must be willing and able to support travel up to 50% to include extended trips both domestic and international
- Must be willing and able to support varying shifts, overtime, and holidays as needed to support business objectives
- Must be willing to obtain and maintain the appropriate medical clearance(s), as defined per the customer’s contracting requirements, for the duration of your employment.
- Must be willing to obtain and maintain all training qualifications, as needed per the customer’s contracting requirements, for the duration of your employment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

- Hold or be able to obtain a Top Secret clearance.
- Internationally recognized Test Pilot School graduate or be able to obtain a NAVAIR Test Pilot School (TPS) waiver.
- Experience working with foreign military personnel.
- Aviation curriculum development experience.
- Naval Aviation or USAF Safety Officer School graduate.
- NATOPS model manager or experience.
- Instructor pilot experience.
- Carrier suitability, structural loads, engine/propeller test experience, and Aerial Refueling test experience desired.

Primary Level Salary Range: $214,200.00 - $321,200.00
  
  
The above salary range represents a general guideline; however, Northrop Grumman considers a number of factors when determining base salary offers such as the scope and responsibilities of the position and the candidate's experience, education, skills and current market conditions.
  
  
Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay. Annual bonuses are designed to reward individual contributions as well as allow employees to share in company results. Employees in Vice President or Director positions may be eligible for Long Term Incentives. In addition, Northrop Grumman provides a variety of benefits including health insurance coverage, life and disability insurance, savings plan, Company paid holidays and paid time off (PTO) for vacation and/or personal business.
  
  
The application period for the job is estimated to be 20 days from the job posting date. However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates.

For our complete EEO and pay transparency statement, please visit http://www.northropgrumman.com/EEO. U.S. Citizenship is required for all positions with a government clearance and certain other restricted positions.

Case IQ is a leading B2B SaaS company in the governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) space, helping organizations build safer, more accountable workplaces. We offer a comprehensive suite of solutions that enable organizations to move from reactive approaches to proactive risk management. Our software helps teams across compliance, HR, legal, and investigations report, manage, investigate, and prevent workplace risk - including ethics violations, fraud, harassment, discrimination, security incidents, and third-party issues - so they can better protect their people, culture, and business.

Backed by over 25 years of domain expertise and trusted by Fortune 500 companies, Case IQ has supported the management of millions of cases and helped mitigate billions in financial and reputational risk.

**Role Summary**

We’re looking for an Implementation Lead to perform a pivotal role in driving a customer and value proposition centric approach to implementing and configuring our investigative case management SaaS offerings.

In this role, you will be the main point of contact for our customers during the implementation process and you will oversee project management, product configuration, integration and migration requirements gathering/documentation, user training, and post-launch adoption tasks for some of our largest customers. You will become a product and investigative process expert and leverage that knowledge to plan and execute high quality customer onboardings to ensure successful delivery of value to our customers.

**What You'll Do**

- Own the full implementation lifecycle from contract signing through go-live and early adoption for new and existing customers
- Lead multiple concurrent implementation projects, maintaining clear timelines, milestones, and documentation
- Gather and translate customer requirements into scalable configuration, integration, and migration solutions
- Configure and support integrations (APIs, webhooks, batch data transfers) and oversee data migration processes
- Develop deep expertise in our product and investigative workflows to guide customers toward best practices
- Deliver engaging user training and enablement to drive successful adoption and long-term value
- Act as a trusted advisor to customers, proactively identifying risks, challenges, and opportunities
- Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, and Support to resolve issues and improve delivery
- Provide structured feedback on product gaps, contribute to requirements, and support testing of new features
- Analyze implementation performance and customer outcomes, surfacing insights and improvement opportunities
- Continuously refine implementation processes to increase efficiency, scalability, and customer impact
- Maintain and promote high standards of security, confidentiality, and compliance while handling company systems, customer information, and internal processes.

**What Success Looks Like**

- **45 days**
  : Complete onboarding, role-specific training, and required security/compliance expectations. Build context on Case IQ's products, customers, systems, team processes, and role priorities.
- **60 days:**
  Shadow or support active customer implementations, learn delivery tools/templates, and begin owning defined workstreams with support.
- **90 days:**
  Manage implementation tasks or projects with increasing independence, clear customer communication, and accurate documentation
- **6 months**
  : Contribute to predictable delivery, cleaner handoffs, reduced rework, and improved customer readiness for launch or adoption.
- **1 year:**
  Serve as a trusted implementation partner who helps customers achieve successful launches and supports continuous improvement of delivery practices.

**Who You Are**

- 2-3 years experience in implementation, project delivery, business analysis, customer onboarding, training, or a related customer-facing role.
- Strong organizational, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
- Ability to translate requirements into clear plans, workflows, documentation, or customer enablement materials.
- Comfort managing timelines, risks, competing priorities, and customer expectations.
- Solid understanding of data migrations and integration models (APIs, webhooks, batch processing)
- Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with strong stakeholder management abilities
- Highly organized with strong attention to detail and follow-through
- Collaborative team player who can also operate independently
- Growth-oriented mindset with a commitment to continuous learning and improvement
- Experience in a B2B SaaS, technology, professional services, GRC, compliance, HR, legal, investigations, or risk-related environment (an asset!)

**Perks and Benefits**

- Work remotely within a flexible work environment (our team spans 7 countries!)
- Competitive company-paid benefits plan starting day 1!
- Generous professional development budget
- RRSP/ 401k matching program
- Half-day Fridays in the summer

Selected candidates will be contacted through BambooHR (please check your junk mail).

Case IQ is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants are given consideration regardless of race, religion, color, gender, sex,

age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, marital status, citizenship status, disability, veteran status, or any other protected class as provided in applicable employment laws. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact us at hr@caseiq.com.

data.job_title: Key Account Manager (KAM) - Hospitals; Anti-infectives - Detroit, MI
data.description:
The KAM position is focused on establishing access and demand for a novel hospital antibiotic product to hospitals and hospital systems within an assigned territory. This includes educating formulary decision makers, key stakeholders, and clinicians on the clinical benefits of the product and establishing and gaining formulary adoption within the institutional IV antibiotic space. The KAM will be responsible for formulary access and sales at the top institutions in the U.S.
  
  
KAMs are responsible for calling on a variety of targeted healthcare professionals within the institutional setting, planning, implementing and taking ownership of their territory plans to enhance institutional awareness and access to Shionogi’s Anti-infective product(s). To do this successfully, they must have a deep understanding of how to navigate these institutions and systems in order to gain access to and impact these key decision makers.
  
  
The ideal KAM should have a strong knowledge base in infectious disease, microbiology and how hospital products are purchased, ordered, administered and established for formulary inclusion within the hospital setting. The ability to communicate complex clinical data to ID physicians, Pharmacists and microbiology labs is key, in order to demonstrate competence and communication of a highly scientific space to evidence driven stakeholders. KAMs are also required to understand the formulary process and reimbursement policies for targeted institutions and systems. The KAMs should also possess strong analytical skills and embrace opportunities for growth and expanded responsibility.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

- Establish clinical understanding and demand within ID physician, pharmacist and microbiology community for target accounts.
- Promote product in the geographical area by navigating the institutional formulary approval process, as well as educating customers on appropriate use of products.
- Understand and leverage the access landscape to establish/expand institutional product access through effective engagement with Pharmacy Directors, ID Pharmacists, ID Physicians, Microbiologists, and other key customers.
- Effectively and consistently call on and educate physicians and other stakeholders within targeted institutions on the use of Shionogi’s anti-infective product(s) through one-on-one meetings and presentations, professional education programs and other appropriate means.
- Deep knowledge of hospital practices including formulary management and pharmaceutical product review.
- Establish professional relationships and maintain an effective communication network with the customer at multiple levels, including ID opinion leaders, key hospital medical staff, pharmacies and more.
- Create opportunities for product education while enhancing Shionogi’s image and commitment to medicine, working directly with local/regional thought leaders and professional societies.
- Responsible for ensuring high level of call and field productivity; expected to meet and exceed expectations for call plans, with five full-time days in the field each week.
- Collaborate with Regional Account Management, Market Access Leadership, Medical Affairs, and Marketing on all needs and opportunities, KOL touch points, and formulary changes.
- Identify and communicate field issues, opportunities and competitive activities through appropriate organizational venues.
- Achieve formulary adoption goals within territory while adhering to all ethical market access practices and required regulations.
- Execute brand strategies to ensure a consistent company marketing message.
- Analyze territory information and insights to develop and execute effective account plans, optimize routing, and maximize field resources to achieve results.
- Responsible for accurately reporting field activities, territory expenses and submitting written reports as necessary by the deadline set forth and defined by Shionogi management.
- Develop positive and interactive relationships with peers, customer and company managers
- Perform Company business in accordance with all regulations (i.e., PDMA/Sample), Company policy and procedures. Demonstrates high ethical and professional standards at all times.
- Actively pursue continuous learning and professional development on efficient sales, communication, managed care and product knowledge training.
- Appropriately manage and maintain all company equipment and promotional materials (company literature, computer, etc.) according to necessary company guidelines.
- Attend all company-sponsored meetings as directed by company management (POAs, National Meetings, National/Regional Conventions, etc.). In-person attendance may be required according to most current company policy.

**Minimum Job Requirements**
**Qualifications**

- BS/BA degree required.
- Hospital-based pharmaceutical experience is required.
- Demonstrated experience in hospital or health system environments with anti-infective, critical care or intravenous experience is strongly preferred.
- Must successfully complete all relevant training and certify in product knowledge for the assigned product(s) within a reasonable time frame.
- Strong understanding of how hospital products are purchased, ordered and administered which include knowledge of the formulary process and reimbursement policies.
- Ability to understand and navigate hospital systems in order to gain access to key decision makers.
- Experience in building rapport and relationships within the institutional setting in order expand awareness and utilization of product(s) and make an immediate impact on healthcare professionals
- Demonstrated track record of successful facilitation of educational programs.
- Ability to communicate clinical data in order to demonstrate competence and communication of a high-level scientific product.
- Successful hospital antibiotic launch experience is a plus.
- Successful experience in establishing hospital product formulary approval through P & T (pharmacy and therapeutic committees) within the IV antibiotic or related category.
- Successful experience with the coordination of account related events.
- Business to business experience and/or ability to demonstrate strong influencing skills.
- Documented record of performance and achievement.

**Competencies**

- Excellent oral, presentation and written communication skills.
- Strong organizational, interpersonal and listening skills.
- Thrives in an ever-changing environment.
- Ability to work independently and collaborate internally as a team member to deliver results.
- Proactive; can do approach, takes ownership of situations.
- Demonstrated self-starter, highly motivated, problem-solving skills.
- Digital competence; ability to deliver presentations digitally using iPad.
- Proficient in MS Office Suite; Word, PowerPoint, Excel and Outlook.

**Other Requirements**

- Must reside within the boundaries of the assigned geographic territory.
- Driving in a safe manner to required meetings and appointments.
- Valid driver’s license with a clean driving record and ability to pass a complete background check.
- Must have valid licenses and credentialing required to conduct business in assigned territory.
- Ability and willingness to travel approximately 80% of the year.
- Ability to drive or fly to various meetings and conventions.
- Some overnight and/or weekend travel may be required.

**Essential Physical And Mental Requirements**- Ability to articulate clearly and conduct verbal presentations with large and small audiences.
- Ability to travel via automobile and/or airplane.
Ability to view video display terminal images < 18” away from face for extended period of time – up to four (4) hours at a time.- Ability to operate a computer keyboard and telephone.
- Ability to sit for extended periods of time – up to four (4) hours at a time.
- Ability to lift, tug, pull up to fifteen (15) pounds.
Additional Information
  
  
The base salary range for this full-time, field-based position is $155,000-$180,000. Individual pay is determined by several factors, which include but are not limited to: job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. The range does not include the comprehensive benefits, vehicle allowance, bonus, long-term incentive, or any additional compensation that may be associated with this role.
  
  
To be considered for this position, you must apply and meet the requirements of this opportunity. We look forward to reviewing your resume & qualifications.
  
  
**Disclaimer**
The job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of requirements, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee. Other requirements, duties and responsibilities may change or be assigned at any time with or without notice.

**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Customer Support Specialist, Infinity based in United States.**
As a Customer Support Specialist, you will serve as a trusted point of contact for a portfolio of 20 to 40 clients across the United States and Canada. You will provide timely, accurate, and professional support while troubleshooting technical issues and helping users make the most of a highly customizable software platform. The role combines customer service, technical problem-solving, product knowledge, and ongoing client education. You will manage support requests across phone, chat, and email while collaborating with Developers and Business Analysts on complex issues. You will also contribute to knowledge sharing, product feedback, and continuous improvements to support processes. This is a full-time, fully remote opportunity with a collaborative environment and opportunities for continuous learning and career growth.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

- Manage incoming customer support requests across phone, chat, and email, triaging inquiries, creating tickets when necessary, and ensuring issues are resolved efficiently.
- Provide professional and accurate assistance on a wide range of requests, from password resets and functionality questions to more complex technical issues.
- Deliver real-time customer support and maintain consistent follow-up to ensure timely resolution and a positive client experience.
- Research complex issues thoroughly by reviewing historical data, previous tickets, internal documentation, and available team knowledge to identify effective solutions.
- Collaborate closely with Developers, Business Analysts, and other internal stakeholders to investigate issues and develop client-focused resolutions.
- Participate actively in team meetings, training sessions, webinars, and knowledge-sharing activities.
- Gather and communicate client feedback and enhancement requests to Product and Development teams.
- Support customers through product updates and new releases by providing guidance and training on new functionality.
- Contribute to continuous learning, documentation, knowledge sharing, and improvements to support processes and workflows.
- Adapt to evolving support technologies, including automated ticketing systems, chatbots, and AI-enhanced help desk tools.

**Requirements**

- At least 2 years of experience in technical customer support, ideally within a startup, scale-up, or other fast-paced environment.
- Strong service-oriented and solution-focused approach, with the initiative and autonomy to investigate and resolve customer issues independently.
- Availability to work from 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Pacific Time (PST).
- Proficiency with Microsoft Office, databases, and remote access tools.
- Ability to quickly learn new technologies, software releases, and product functionality.
- Comfortable working with emerging support technologies such as chatbots, automated ticketing platforms, and AI-enhanced help desk systems.
- Strong analytical, critical-thinking, problem-solving, organizational, and attention-to-detail skills.
- Ability to identify patterns, reference previous resolutions, and build on existing documentation when troubleshooting issues.
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to build trust and maintain strong customer relationships.
- Ability to explain technical information clearly to non-technical audiences and communicate confidently with customers at different levels.
- Strong collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively within a fully remote team.

data.description:
**Job Title: Client Experience Manager – Early Morning + Flexible Schedule (Full-Time, Remote | B2B SaaS)**
**Start early. Make an impact. Choose when you finish your day.**
Looking to bring your clinical experience into healthcare technology—with a schedule that gives you more flexibility? This fully remote, full-time role combines a consistent early morning shift with the freedom to choose when you work the remaining four hours of your day.
  
  
**You’ll work Monday–Friday, with required coverage from 4:00–8:00 a.m. Eastern Time. You choose when to work your remaining four hours later that day, provided they are worked in one consecutive block. Weekends are off.**
Prompt is revolutionizing healthcare by delivering highly automated and modern software to rehab therapy businesses, the teams within, and the patients they serve. As the fastest growing company in the therapy EMR space and the new standard in healthcare technology, we’re looking to bring on an Early Morning Client Experience Manager to help ensure exceptional client support and smooth software experiences as our clinics begin their day.
  
  
This role is an unprecedented opportunity to have an immense impact on our industry leading Client Success Team that ranks 85 Net Promoter Score points higher than our competition (in other words, people love Prompt). We’re looking for someone scrappy, willing to bring new ideas, take on big challenges, and interested in doubling down on what works.
  
  
We’re doing something special here, and this role will be critical in taking Prompt to the next level.
  
  
**Hours & Schedule: Built Around an Early Start, With Flexibility After**
This is a full-time, eight-hour-per-day role with a Monday–Friday schedule:
  
  

- Your fixed hours: 4:00–8:00 a.m. Eastern Time each weekday.
- Your flexible hours: You choose when to work an additional four consecutive hours later that same day.
- Your weekends: Saturdays and Sundays off.

Want to keep your workday together? Your additional block could follow your morning coverage. Prefer a longer break between blocks? You could return for a four-hour afternoon or evening block.
  
  
**The flexibility is in when you work your second block.**
Those four hours must be worked consecutively, rather than split into smaller increments, and you’ll be actively available to support customers throughout both work blocks.
  
  
**Why Work for Prompt?**

- BIG Challenges: Here at Prompt, we are solving complex and unique problems that have plagued the healthcare industry since the dawn of time.
- Talented People: Prompt didn't happen by chance. It's a team of incredibly talented and proven individuals who all made their mark before joining forces to build the greatest software on the planet for rehab therapists.
- Healthy Approach: At Prompt, we value smart work and ownership. This role pairs consistent early morning coverage with meaningful flexibility in how you schedule the rest of your workday.
- Positive Impact: Prompt helps outpatient rehab organizations treat more patients and deliver better care with less environmental waste. That means less surgery and less narcotic-based pain treatment, all while turning a paper-heavy industry digital. We aren't enthralled with patting ourselves on the back every day, but it does feel good :)

**The Role**
You’ll provide customer support through our email support channel, including essential early morning coverage as clinics begin their day. You’ll handle incoming tickets, investigate reported issues, identify trends, and collaborate with Engineering to log, prioritize, and communicate about issues effectively.
  
  
You’ll act as the bridge between customer experience and product stability, helping clinics navigate questions and resolve issues, including those that arise following product releases.
  
  
Within six months, you’ll have established yourself as a key contributor—comfortable supporting both the clinical and billing sides of the software—by demonstrating initiative, technical understanding, and exceptional communication skills.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

- Develop and maintain a deep understanding of our product offerings to effectively respond to incoming customer inquiries across our single-channel support system.
- Provide timely, accurate customer support through our email support channel during your early morning coverage and additional scheduled work block.
- Work primarily within the clinical side of the platform while maintaining a working knowledge of billing modules to identify, document, and escalate billing issues.
- Troubleshoot software issues, gather detailed replication steps, and write clear, actionable engineering tickets; collaborate with Engineering to prioritize and monitor resolutions.
- Proactively identify and escalate urgent issues that impact production environments or multiple customers.
- Contribute to internal process improvements and knowledge base updates to enhance support efficiency and scalability.
- Promote customer satisfaction and advocate for an exceptional experience by understanding each customer’s unique needs, delivering value in every interaction, and identifying opportunities to enhance our product and service features.
- Take on tasks beyond defined job responsibilities as needed, demonstrating adaptability and a willingness to contribute to broader team goals.
- Collaborate closely with the rest of the CX team to ensure clear handoffs and continuity on customer issues and follow-ups.

**Minimum Requirements**

- Experience as a rehab clinician, such as an SLP, OT, PT, COTA, or PTA.
- Availability to work Monday–Friday from 4:00–8:00 a.m. Eastern Time, plus an additional four consecutive hours later each day.
- Highly analytical mindset with a strong ability to troubleshoot and test software use cases and issues.
- Proactive, self-motivated, and resourceful learner capable of working independently with limited oversight.
- Experience thriving in dynamic work settings that demand adaptability and efficiency.
- Comfort working in a fast-paced environment and prioritizing customer needs.
- High proficiency in MS Excel.
- Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.

**Preferred (Nice-to-Have) Qualifications**

- 1–3 years of experience on a Support or CX team.
- Prior startup and/or B2B SaaS organization experience.
- Knowledge of e-clinical systems and technologies, such as EMR, RTM, HEP, CRM, and HIEs.
- Comfort handling cross-functional communication with Engineering and Product teams.
- Technical proficiency with foundational device and network troubleshooting.
- Proven ability to handle multiple projects, shift gears quickly, and meet deadlines while maintaining professional composure.
- Experience with Zendesk or similar customer support software.

**Perks – What You Can Expect**

- Competitive salaries
- Fully remote role
- Flexible scheduling following your required early morning coverage
- Potential equity compensation for outstanding performance
- Flexible PTO
- Company-wide sponsored lunches
- Company paid disability and life insurance benefits
- Company paid family and medical leave
- Medical, dental, and vision insurance benefits
- Discounted pet insurance
- FSA/DCA and commuter benefits
- 401k
- Complimentary subscription to digital fitness classes and wellness content
- Recovery suite at HQ – includes a cold plunge, sauna, and shower

We believe in upholding strong professional relationships and respecting the agreements and commitments our customers have with their employees. We appreciate your understanding and cooperation regarding this policy. Please don't hesitate to inquire with our team.*

Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. We are seeking a committed professional to join our team. While this is a remote position not located at a physical Medtronic site, the candidate hired will be required to reside within the territory and drive to multiple accounts throughout the region. A valid driver's license is essential for this role.
  
  
Cardiac Ablation Solutions offers cardiac mapping and ablation solutions to treat patients with abnormal heart rhythms. Our vision is to help patients worldwide by advancing innovation for the diagnosis and ablation of cardiac arrhythmias, enabling clinicians to perform procedures with superior outcomes.
  
  
Join Medtronic as an EP Mapping Specialist and be at the forefront of transforming lives through advanced medical technology! In this dynamic role, you’ll work alongside a collaborative team of clinicians, engineers, physicians, and innovators to execute solutions for cardiac and other electrophysiological systems. By blending technical expertise with a passion for improving patient outcomes, you'll have the opportunity to impact global healthcare directly. Must have a valid driver's license and active vehicle insurance policy.  In addition, your driving record will be reviewed and will be considered as part of your application.
  
  
For Baccalaureate degrees earned outside of the United States, a degree that satisfies the requirements of 8 C.F.R.
